landing.heroSubtitle: Buy credits, use any AI model. Pay only for what you use, with transparent pricing.
landing.feature1Desc: Access the best models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) through a single endpoint, with real-time streaming.
landing.feature2Desc: No hidden fees. See exactly how much each request costs before you make it.
landing.feature3Desc: Qolari IDE: a desktop code editor with built-in AI. Windows and Linux.
landing.feature4Desc: Pay in EUR, USD or GBP. Local pricing without surprise conversions.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Choose the package that fits you. No monthly fee.
landing.faq1A: You buy a credit package in USD. Each AI request debits the exact cost (tokens x model price x margin). Balance never expires before 12 months.
landing.faq2A: We currently support Claude Sonnet, GPT-4o and Gemini Flash. New models are added regularly.
landing.faq3Q: Do I need a credit card?
landing.faq3A: Not to sign up. You only need a payment method when purchasing credits (via Stripe).
landing.faq4Q: Can I use it on multiple machines?
landing.faq4A: Yes. Create API tokens in the dashboard and use them on any machine with Qolari IDE or via direct API.

marketplace.title: Qolari Ecosystem
marketplace.subtitle: Our product portfolio — built to scale, ready for market.
marketplace.ecosystemDesc: Each product targets a different market vertical but shares the same DNA: modern architecture, mobile-first, and built for growth. Together they form a diversified tech portfolio with multiple revenue streams.
marketplace.investDesc: We are open to strategic partnerships and investment rounds. Get in touch to discuss opportunities.

qolaridriver.name: QolariDriver
qolaridriver.description: A complete ride-sharing solution with real-time dispatch, zone management, fare calculation, and parcel delivery. Drivers bid on trips, users track rides live, and admins control everything from one panel.

qolarifood.name: QolariFood
qolarifood.description: A full super-app marketplace supporting food delivery, grocery, pharmacy, parcel, and rental — all in one platform. Vendors get their own panel and app, deliverymen manage routes, and customers enjoy a seamless shopping experience.
qolarifood.feature1: 6 business modules (Food, Grocery, Pharmacy, Shop, Parcel, Rental)

noaholive.name: Noah & Olive
noaholive.description: A marketplace connecting families with verified home care providers for elderly support. Features Uber-style cascading dispatch, geolocated check-in/out, execution reports with photos, Stripe Connect payments, and a reputation system.
